what: Chart calibration from real on-chain trades, anonymized. Our estimate from public Solana data, not Bubblemaps' data and not a finding about any person.
method: 5-second OHLCV candles from every successful trade on the token's Pump.fun bonding curve, 10 min before to 30 min after the public wallet's first buy. Price = SOL per token at the curve (curve balance change), divided by the curve price of the public wallet's buy, so that buy = 1.0. t = seconds from that buy (bucket start). Empty buckets are flat at the previous close (empty: true). Events: group wallets' trades; slot_offset = Solana slots from the public buy's slot (~0.4 s each); order_in_slot = rank among the group's trades in that same slot (exact block order). SOL amounts rounded to 0.1, volumes to 0.01 SOL.
caveats: Timing and shared funding do not prove who controls a wallet.
Call (post) times are not on-chain; events are relative to the public wallet's first buy, not to the call.
Candles were validated: high >= max(open, close), low <= min(open, close), all prices > 0.

tokens.why_chosen: Fast flip: the group's four buys landed in one block seconds after launch; all four sold about 30 s later.
tokens.reference: curve price of the public wallet's first buy

tokens.why_chosen: Staged exit: side wallets sold in about 7 tranches from 2 to 10 minutes after the public buy while the public wallet kept buying.
tokens.volume_unit: SOL-equivalent (curve quoted in another token; converted at the public buy's own SOL-per-quote ratio)
